working_definition: Davie 2018 Table S2 res-2.0 cluster 20, annotated by the authors as 'L1/L2/L3/L4/L5' (lamina monopolar neurons; mapping, Tan et al. 2015); sub-clustered into L1, L2, L3 and L4/L5.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Monopolar, intrinsic unicolumnar neuron of the adult optic lobe that has its soma in the cell body rind of the lamina and connects the lamina to the medulla (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It has a single major projection that projects along one optic cartridge in the lamina, crosses the first optic chiasm and terminates in the same cartridge in the medulla (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989).

justification: The authors' call is a group of lamina monopolar neuron types L1-L5, so the most specific common parent is lamina monopolar neuron (FBbt:00003718). OLS ancestors of L4 (FBbt:00003722) and L5 (FBbt:00003725) include it; L1-L3 are its children. The term is adult-specific by definition.
